details: CONFIRMED by reading and by the change's own test. The queue item's failing case is "the checker runs `relay
changed --own -C <wt> <reviewed>` and gets every openspec/specs and openspec/changes/archive path ... Should be: the
checker and the merge guard agree". The change adds a flag but no caller passes it: git grep for "changed --own"
plugins/openspec/agents/spec-conformance.md:112, spec-reviewer.md:114, all without --archive. The builder's own
report says "Checker texts still call without the flag (not updated)". Closing the item now (relay queue done)
would drop the record of a defect that still reproduces: a promise of the change broken, hence HIGH.
Size: 15 (judge.md two lines, test_roles assertion, relay sync of the agent copies); 10 with the --own alternative.
evidence: plugins/delegate/agents/checker.md:119:   files with `relay changed --own -C <path> <since>`: it prints the changed

failing_case: Branch with a mark on C; then an archive-only commit (openspec/changes/x moved to openspec/changes/archive/2026-x,
openspec/specs/word/spec.md written). The checker follows roles/judge.md check step 1 (and the generated
plugins/delegate/agents/checker.md:119 that carries it) and runs `relay changed --own -C <wt> C`.
Now: it prints the 5 archive paths (as tests/test_archive_inert.py:149 itself asserts for the no-flag call); with
`Fixes: none` that is a new problem "changed since the review", open 1, merge refused, while the merge guard
(merge.py:298/312, archive=True) treats the same commit as inert.
Should: the checker's file list for that span is empty, so the check records open 0, as the merge guard sees it.
fix_hint: Either (a) add --archive to roles/judge.md step 1 and to step 2's `relay changed -C <path> <sha>`, update
tests/test_roles.py:285, run relay sync so the agent copies follow (a checked path: rides the next wave's paid run);
or (b) in bin/relay cmd_changed, make --own imply archive=True (the merge guard never uses own without archive)
and keep --archive for the no-own gate comparison; then judge step 1 needs no edit, pass case 3 of the item changes.
pass_cases: 1. Artifact: roles/judge.md check step 1 names the archive-filtered list, e.g. "List the files with `relay changed --own --archive -C <path> <since>`" (or the --own call, if --own is made to imply the filter), and the generated checker.md / critic.md / spec-conformance.md / spec-reviewer.md carry the same line after relay sync.
2. Artifact: check step 2's gate rule ("`relay changed -C <path> <sha>` lists no file") uses the same archive filter as the merge guard's step_gate (merge.py:354, archive=True).
3. The command the checker text names, run after an archive-only commit on top of mark C, prints nothing.
4. The same command with a README.md edit in the archive commit prints README.md only.
5. tests/test_roles.py A15 (line 285) asserts the updated step-1 line, so a later edit that drops the filter fails.
reason: roles/judge.md:103,123 carry --archive; tests/test_roles.py test_judge_base_part2 fails before fix, passes.

details: CONFIRMED by reading: lib/relay_verdict.py:751 `moved = relay_inert.changed(wt, logged, head)`; merge.py:354 and
relay_marks.py:325 use archive=True for the same question. This is the second place where the checker and the merge
guard disagree on what an archive changes, the disagreement the queue item names in its Why. The Gate: none path
(line 717) already drops openspec/ paths, so only the gate-log path is affected. Inside because the item's promise
("the checker and the merge guard agree on what an archive changes") cannot hold while the check record adds this N.
Size: 15 (one argument plus a test in tests/test_verdict*.py on a scratch repo).
evidence: lib/relay_verdict.py:751:        moved = relay_inert.changed(wt, logged, head) if _is_commit(wt, logged) else None
plugins/relay/hooks/merge.py:354:        since = relay_inert.changed(main, commit, ref, archive=True)
lib/relay_marks.py:325:            ungated = relay_inert.changed(repo, gate[0], ref, archive=True)
failing_case: Gate log G green on commit C; then an archive-only commit A on top. The checker records the check with
`gate = "<G>.gate.log"`. _gate runs relay_inert.changed(wt, G, head) with no archive filter, gets the openspec
archive/spec paths, and adds N "the gate log is for other code than head" -> open 1, merge refused.
The merge guard's step_gate (plugins/relay/hooks/merge.py:354) calls changed(main, commit, ref, archive=True)
and accepts G for head A. Should: the record agrees with the guard, no N problem for an archive-only span.
fix_hint: Pass archive=True at lib/relay_verdict.py:751 (and the plugins/relay copy of relay_verdict.py if it is a copy).
pass_cases: 1. Gate G green on C, archive-only commit after it, check recorded with that gate: no N problem, open 0 (given the findings are MET).
2. Gate G green on C, archive commit plus a lib/x.py edit after it: N "the gate log is for other code than head" naming lib/x.py.
3. Gate G green on C, a commit editing openspec/specs/word/spec.md with no archive move: N problem as today.
4. Gate G on head itself: no N problem (unchanged).
findings.summary: `relay check record check` compares the gate log to head without the archive filter, so a gate run before an archive commit becomes an open N finding the merge guard would not raise
